design.objective: Make the file-media editor visually consistent with the surrounding release-application form without changing any business behavior.
users: Release applicants entering one or more file-media paths in the artifact-registration step

requirements.statement: The file-media title and add action must use the same compact field hierarchy as surrounding form controls.
acceptance: The title no longer appears as a section heading
The add-path action shares the title row and uses a compact icon-and-text button
requirements.source: User selected option 1 and confirmed the landed design on 2026-08-20.
counterexample: The title remains substantially larger than form labels
The add button remains visually detached and oversized

requirements.statement: Every path row must use a stable index-input-delete layout with aligned control heights and consistent spacing.
acceptance: Single and multiple rows align to the same three columns
Index, input and delete control remain vertically centered
requirements.source: Visual defect shown in the user screenshot.
counterexample: The row number is visually dominant
The delete button does not align with the input

requirements.statement: The compact layout must remain usable without page-level horizontal overflow on required mobile and desktop viewports.
acceptance: 375x812, 390x844, 430x932 and desktop have no document horizontal overflow
Path input and delete action remain reachable
counterexample: A long path widens the drawer
The delete action is clipped on mobile

requirements.statement: Existing file-media state, validation and payload behavior must remain unchanged.
acceptance: Selecting file media still creates the first row
Add and delete change only the intended row count
Frontend build passes without API type changes
counterexample: The fix changes validation or payload
Adding or deleting a path no longer works

invariants: File-media behavior and payload remain unchanged
Existing Element Plus and design-token conventions are reused
constraints: Modify only file-media markup in ReleaseApplicationDrawer.vue and local rules in release-prototype.css
non_goals: Add file browsing, cards or instructional copy

selected_approach.name: Compact standard form row
selected_approach.reason: It matches the surrounding form hierarchy with the smallest change surface and no nested panel.

alternatives.name: Grouped bordered panel
alternatives.rejected_because: It adds visual weight and an unnecessary container.

alternatives.name: One form item per path
alternatives.rejected_because: It consumes too much vertical space.

components.name: ReleaseApplicationDrawer
components.responsibility: Expose a compact semantic title/action row and stable path rows while retaining handlers.

components.name: release-prototype.css
components.responsibility: Define hierarchy, spacing, stable columns and mobile constraints.

interfaces.name: File-media editor state
interfaces.contract: Markup and CSS do not alter draft.fileMedia or ReleaseApplicationWrite.

error_handling.behavior: Keep existing warning and submission behavior.
Input shrinks and delete remains visible.

compatibility: No state, API, database or saved-data change

verification_strategy.signal: Coherent field hierarchy and stable row alignment.
verification_strategy.method: Desktop browser with one and multiple rows.

verification_strategy.signal: Required viewports have reachable controls and no horizontal overflow.

verification_strategy.method: Browser interaction, npm build and git diff check.

assumptions.text: The issue is visual hierarchy rather than workflow behavior.
assumptions.basis: The user selected the standard-form-row option.
assumptions.falsifier: The user requests a workflow change.

decisions.decision: Use compact standard-form-row without a panel.
Keep a lower-emphasis icon-and-text add action.
decisions.reason: Clear without competing with primary actions.

decisions.decision: Retain compact circular danger delete icon.

risks.mitigation: Dedicated local classes and browser checks.

risks.risk: Three columns become cramped on mobile.
risks.mitigation: minmax input and fixed compact side columns.

approval.evidence: The user explicitly confirmed the landed option-1 design and direct implementation on 2026-08-20.

global_constraints: Only local file-media markup and CSS
No behavior, API, dependency, commit or push changes
Verify desktop and three mobile viewports

tasks.goal: Unify the file-media field hierarchy and path-row layout without behavior changes.
input_facts: The editor markup is localized in ReleaseApplicationDrawer.vue line 197
The corresponding CSS is localized at release-prototype.css lines 339-354
Existing handlers already implement required behavior

steps.expected: Screenshot and DOM reproduce hierarchy, weight and alignment defects

steps.action: Adjust only the file-media local markup
steps.expected: Existing state and handlers remain unchanged
Single and multiple rows align without overflow
steps.evidence: Scoped CSS diff and DOM geometry

steps.action: Verify browser interaction and required viewports
steps.expected: Add/delete work, controls align, no console errors or horizontal overflow
steps.evidence: Screenshots, row counts, DOM measurements and console

steps.expected: Exit 0 and product changes limited to two approved files

tasks.rollback: Restore only the local file-media markup and corresponding CSS rules.
stop_conditions: A global theme or business-state change is required
Existing add/delete behavior is already broken before the edit
escalation_conditions: User requests workflow or validation changes

approval.evidence: The user confirmed direct planning and implementation after reviewing design revision 1.

plant_boundary_candidates: ReleaseApplicationDrawer file-media DOM and local CSS
interface_candidates: Existing toggle, add, remove, v-model and submit contracts

assumptions.text: Local markup and CSS are sufficient.
assumptions.basis: The defect is localized and current handlers already work.
assumptions.falsifier: Browser measurement proves a global layout rule is the cause.
